note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2): each figure acts out its word's new hook. Stone pillar in the middle: feminine words left (with the stairs up), masculine right (with the studded street door and the bar alcove that opens the zoom). One box per item.

items.label: la bouteille
items.scene: A BOOT (boo-TEHY) sticks out of the neck of a huge green BOTTLE.

items.label: la cave
items.scene: A CALF (KAHV) curls up at the foot of the stone steps in the dim wine CELLAR.

items.label: la vigne
items.scene: A TEENY gnome (VEENY) climbs a curling grape VINE heavy with purple bunches.

items.label: la vodka
items.scene: Same as English 'vodka' (stress at the end, vod-KAH): a frosty bottle of VODKA stands in a bucket of ice.

items.label: l'ivresse
items.scene: EVE RESTS (ee-VREHS) on a barrel, eyes swirling, giddy with a HEADY THRILL after the grape-stomping.

items.label: la brasserie
items.scene: Same as English 'brasserie' (said brah-suh-REE): a waiter in a long white apron carries tankards through a busy BRASSERIE.

items.label: l'appellation
items.scene: Same as English 'appellation' (said ah-pay-lah-SYOHN): an old winemaker presses the red NAME-OF-ORIGIN wax seal onto his bottle.

items.label: la capsule
items.scene: Same as English 'capsule' (said kahp-SEWL): a squirrel collects shiny BOTTLE CAPS in an acorn cup.

items.label: la dégustation
items.scene: At a TASTING table, a goat makes a DISGUSTED face (day-GEWS-) at one glass, then grins at the next.

items.label: le verre
items.scene: A puzzled bear scratches its head: 'WHERE?' (VEHR) — but the GLASS is right there in its own paw.

items.label: le vin
items.scene: A little delivery VAN (VAN) unloads crates of WINE bottles.

items.label: l'alcool
items.scene: Old AL heaves a sack of COAL (ahl-KOL) past the cellar rack of ALCOHOL bottles.

items.label: le champagne
items.scene: Same as English 'champagne' (said shahn-PAHNY): a cork pops from a CHAMPAGNE bottle and the fizz sprays a startled hedgehog.

items.label: le bouchon
items.scene: A ghost shouts 'BOO!' (boo-SHOHN) and the CORK shoots out of a bottle.

items.label: le tonneau
items.scene: A boy yelps 'TOE! NO!' (toh-NOH) as a big wooden BARREL rolls towards his foot.

items.label: le cru
items.scene: A CREW (KREW) of three grape-pickers proudly holds up one dusty bottle of their famous VINTAGE.
